{{Short description|none}}The '''Belgian football champions''' are the winners of the highest [[association football]] league in Belgium, currently called the [[Belgian Pro League]] and historically the Belgian First Division.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.rsssf.org/tablesb/belghist.html|title=Belgium - Final Tables 1895-2008}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.footbel.com/fr/Competitites/statistieken/eindklassemente_hogere_afdelingen.html |title=Classements finals des divisions supérieures |access-date=2011-01-31 |url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110716055248/http://www.footbel.com/fr/Competitites/statistieken/eindklassemente_hogere_afdelingen.html |archive-date=2011-07-16 }}</ref>
